high_level_description: This image depicts a statue of a person standing on a pedestal, located outdoors with a scenic background. The statue is painted blue and appears to be made of metal or a similar material. The figure is dressed in what looks like traditional attire, possibly a uniform or ceremonial clothing, with a pointed hat. The pedestal is black and has a plaque attached to it, which contains text written in Tamil script. The text provides information about the individual commemorated by the statue. The date "15-12-1937" is visible, suggesting the significance of that date to the person being honored.
